purpose: Teach: 鍛冶/臨場/北極/トップニュース/被写体/防い/訃報/何もの

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、伝統の、本気で、絶対、鍛冶、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, I was genuinely impressed by how thoroughly you handled the traditional blacksmithing techniques in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Soft emphasis on 'genuinely impressed.' Nod in the voice. Teacher-to-student directness without formality.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。映画の、本気で、絶対、臨場、絶対、感、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to really capture the immediacy and intensity of the filmmaking in my research—it was important to dig deep.
lines.style: Sincere and slightly formal in gratitude. Slight lean forward in the voice. Not defensive, but earnest about the work that went in.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地理学の、本気で、絶対、北極、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: Your geography paper on Arctic research showed such breadth of vision. That was really impressive work.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight pause before 'breadth.' Speaking to Sakura as someone whose perspective has genuinely widened.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。報道の、本気で、絶対、トップニュース、絶対、選別、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to really examine how major news stories are selected and shaped. It took serious research to understand that depth.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Hands in lap in the voice. Not boasting—explaining what the work demanded of her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 肖像画の、本気で、絶対、被写体、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your work on portraiture was striking. The way you analyzed your subjects was remarkable.
lines.style: Engaged, direct. Slight quickening on 'was remarkable'—genuine warmth breaking through. Eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、感染症を、絶対、防いだ、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. During wartime, there were so many disease-prevention efforts that went unrecorded. I wanted to bring that research to light—it mattered.
lines.style: Firm underneath the courtesy. Not asking for credit, but insisting the work deserved it. Slow on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文学者の、本気で、絶対、訃報、絶対、社会的影響、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your paper on a literary figure's death and their social impact was really thoughtful. I was moved by it.
lines.style: Gentler. Slower pace. Slight vulnerability in 'moved by it'—teacher speaking honestly, not performing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。哲学的に、本気で、絶対、何もの、絶対、でもない、絶対、概念、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The philosophical concept of nothingness—of being nothing and everything at once—it required such careful thinking. I'm grateful for the space to explore it.
lines.style: Slow, measured, almost meditative. Closing inward slightly. Not finishing strong—trailing softly, as if still sitting with the idea.
